name: tackquote/woocommerce
description: Development tooling for the TackQuote: Request a Quote & B2B Wholesale for WooCommerce plugin: WordPress + WooCommerce coding standards (PHPCS) and PHPStan with WordPress + WooCommerce stubs. The plugin itself has no Composer runtime dependencies; this file and vendor/ never ship in tackquote.zip.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check every PHP file against phpcs.xml.dist (WordPress-Extra, WordPress-Docs, WooCommerce-Core, PHPCompatibilityWP).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Apply the automatic fixes phpcbf can make, then run `composer lint` for what remains.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis (PHPStan level 5, WordPress + WooCommerce stubs) per phpstan.neon.dist; no baseline.
